items.title: OpenAI's first device will reportedly be a 'humanlike' rechargeable speaker
items.excerpt: A new report details OpenAI's debut consumer device as a screenless, rechargeable smart speaker with cameras and sensors, designed by Jony Ive's team to act as a portable, humanlike physical ChatGPT companion.

items.title: Google announces Gemma 4 optimized for the Pixel 10's TPU
items.excerpt: Google unveiled Gemma 4, a new open model tuned to run on the Pixel 10's Tensor G5 TPU, pushing more capable generative AI fully on-device for phones.

items.title: I briefly tried Gemini Intelligence, and I'm still not sure who it's for
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Gemini Intelligence — the on-device, Nano 4-powered agentic layer debuting on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 — which automates multi-app tasks but leaves the reviewer questioning who it's really for.

items.title: Gemini Nano 4 is finally here with Samsung's latest foldables
items.excerpt: Google's newest on-device model, Gemini Nano 4, arrives first on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8, adding support for 140+ languages and stronger multimodal understanding running locally on the phone.

items.title: I went hands-on with Samsung's new Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear
items.excerpt: A hands-on with Samsung's first Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear, built with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster — lightweight Android XR glasses offering hands-free translation, note-taking and navigation.

items.title: Move over Fitbit Air: Garmin's new CIRQA Smart Band is here
items.excerpt: Garmin launched the CIRQA, its first screen-free smart band and a discreet Whoop/Fitbit Air rival, whose Active Intelligence AI insights and coaching sit behind the Connect+ subscription tier.
